who.title: Who I am
who.p1: I'm Nikos, a photographer and filmmaker based in Greece. The camera has always been my way of looking more closely: the light shifting across a face, a hand that holds on a moment longer, the quiet just before the laughter breaks.
who.p2: Today I photograph and film weddings, baptisms, businesses and spaces. The subjects change, the approach stays the same: I listen first, learn what matters to you, then build every frame around the story you want to tell.
who.p3: Every collaboration is a story of its own. I don't arrive with a formula. I arrive prepared and curious, and I work quietly in the background so that, in the end, the images do the talking.

philosophy.title: My philosophy
philosophy.p1: I'm drawn to images with character, atmosphere and substance. Not just beautiful pictures, but images that remind you how that day actually felt.
philosophy.p2: I care about detail and authenticity. Every production is shaped around the person, the brand or the space it presents: its light, its pace, its tone. Because no story should be told twice the same way.
